mainEntity.name: Can an existing concrete walkway be upgraded or resurfaced instead of replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in many cases, an existing concrete walkway can be upgraded or resurfaced rather than fully replaced, depending on its current condition. If the base is sound and there are no significant structural cracks or settling, options like concrete overlays, stamping, staining, or applying decorative coatings can dramatically transform its appearance. Resurfacing can achieve the look of pavers, natural stone, or tile at a potentially lower cost and with less disruption than a full tear-out. We can assess your existing walkway to determine if resurfacing is a viable and cost-effective solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: An existing concrete walkway can often be upgraded with overlays, stamping, staining, or decorative coatings if its base is sound and has no major structural issues, offering a cost-effective alternative to replacement.
